ARURCOHE trains architects and engineers in the rehabilitation of architectural and urban heritage, combining conservation technology with regeneration policy across an Erasmus Mundus consortium. The programme site publishes the current call, scholarship information and mobility structure.

Programme Highlights

  • Heritage-rehabilitation specialisation spanning architecture and planning
  • Studio and fieldwork in European historic urban contexts
  • Call-specific deadlines on the official site
  • Careers in conservation practice, urban regeneration agencies and research

Who Should Apply

Architecture, civil engineering, urban planning and conservation graduates are the natural applicants, with portfolio elements usually required.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students per the live call.

Deadline and How to Apply

Follow the ARURCOHE site for the live call and prepare the portfolio and documents listed there. Key deadline information: Current call and closing date published on the official programme site.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About ARURCOHE Consortium

The ARURCOHE consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Architectural and Urban Rehabilitation with European universities specialised in heritage and regeneration.

Official website: http://arurcohe.com

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: See official page for dates - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
